class.name: HeightmapTerrain3D
class.brief_description: Renders and edits a simple heightmap-based landscape.
class.description: Generates a triangle mesh from a [TerrainHeightmap], including normals, UVs, and vertex colors. The editor provides a brush toolbar for raising, lowering, and coloring the terrain with Undo/Redo. The generated mesh is regenerated when height or color data changes. [b]Note:[/b] The current implementation is intended for small meshes only, as editing any sample rebuilds the entire mesh. Physics collision, tiled LOD, foliage, and world streaming are not generated automatically.

method.name: build_mesh
method.description: Generates an independent mesh from the current heightmap.

method.name: sample_height_local
method.description: Samples the height at local 3D coordinates, accounting for [member cell_size].

members.member: Distance in local units between adjacent samples.
Heightmap resource from which the mesh is generated.
Optional material assigned to the generated surface. By default, a standard material displays the painted vertex colors.
